label: A major television network goes down, and big-platform ministers disappear
description: The Lord saying he is shaking churches and exposing corruption, that a major television network will not be there much longer and will go down too, and that there will be ministers who once had huge platforms and audiences who will no longer be there, alongside a scandal at a major Californian church that he says he has not touched. A network closing and named ministries collapsing would both be matters of record.
aliases: A major TV network won't be there very much longer
there'll be ministers that used to have a platform that were huge
I'm shaking churches, Brandon. I'm exposing corruption

label: No green light on Greenland, and it costs them the midterms
description: The Lord saying there was not a green light to take Greenland, that doing it would cause a great rift in Europe and around the world and come across as bullying, and that he saw it affecting the midterms very negatively. He points to reports of Germany and other NATO allies sending troops to defend Greenland against the United States as the confirmation, and says the enemy would destroy the nation through pride and arrogance.
aliases: there was not a green light to take Greenland
it will cause great rift around the world
I saw this affecting midterms and it was very negative

label: If Jerusalem is split, America is split right down the middle
description: A warning he says he has given before about splitting Jerusalem in a two-state solution: if that happens he saw America split right down the middle. He adds that he does not believe the president is for a two-state solution and that the word went no further than to pray, so he has no instruction on what should be done.
aliases: I've warned about splitting Jerusalem, a two-state solution
I saw America be split right down the middle
that's as far as the word went

label: The asteroid strike wipes out the Caribbean islands and Cuba
description: The asteroid hitting the earth, with the blast breaking all the glass out of houses and cars, and the tsunami from it completely taking out the islands, naming San Juan, Puerto Rico, St Thomas, St Martin and the Bahamas, with Cuba gone as the water went over its mountains. He says he was caught up in the spirit and will never forget it.
aliases: I saw that the asteroid hitting the earth
all the Bahamas were completely gone
Cuba gone. The water from the tsunami of this thing completely took him out
